method: Probes ran in a scratchpad directory outside the repository. Each probe used a throwaway plugin or -c overrides and a stub hook script that logged its stdin and returned fixed outputs. specImpact: D1 must ignore UserPromptSubmit events whose prompt is a <task-notification>.
Claude Code subagents run in the background; team-mode steps must wait for SubagentStop or the notification, not assume synchronous results.
Codex reviewer/planner read-only cannot rely on the role sandbox_mode; enforce with PreToolUse by agent_type (deny apply_patch; Bash only via a read-only allowlist) and record the limitation.
Codex MCP registration needs default_tools_approval_mode="approve" for the jodex server.
Codex hooks need hook trust; jodex setup must use the supported trust flow, never the bypass flag.
Jev calls must set per-call timeout and maxRetries=0 on hook paths, overriding the SDK defaults (10 s, 2 retries).
The Codex PreToolUse gate must parse paths from apply_patch text.

Cold first call (~1.05 s) can exceed the D2 800 ms budget; the hook process is short-lived, so expect fallback on the first gated call of a session unless the timeout allows it. Measured p95 for warm calls is within budget.
Jev model versions change under 'jev-latest'; log the reported version, do not treat a new version as a fallback condition.
Score answers are keyed by rubric index ('0','1','2'); thresholds read probabilities by index.
